alt: Scanning electron micrograph of a faceted, silica-preserved DNA-origami pyrochlore crystal about ten micrometers across, its surface showing the ordered pore pattern of the underlying lattice.
caption: Silica-preserved DNA-origami pyrochlore crystal imaged by scanning electron microscopy; the faceted habit and ordered surface pores follow the designed lattice. Topology and long-range order are established in the linked paper by small-angle X-ray scattering, following interaction design and coarse-grained modeling.
